name: ESP32-C5 mini (timer)
description: The LapDog timer: listens on your 5.8 GHz video channel.
instructions: Plug the board into this computer with a USB-C data cable. It shows up as a USB JTAG/serial port, no driver needed.
If it isn't found, hold BOOT while you plug it in (or press RESET while holding BOOT), then let go and try again.
